mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals reduced supply chain pressures, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above 500 billion signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when RSAFS > 500B are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a shift towards inflationary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5 signals a tight labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when UNRATE < 3.5 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
